name: Lyrical ♪ Lyric
source:
New life, the protagonist comes back to his hometown. On his first day at his new school, he collides with Rin, one of the most beautiful girls at school, in front of the school gate. There is also his childhood friend, Nanao and several students he knows well in his class. Happily or unhappily, his new school life starts...

[From Himeya Shop]
